title: Habit Frequency
body: Hi, First of all I really love your apps. It’s simple and beautiful and also usefull. I have one request though. Regarding habbit frequency, it’s kinda not intuitive to only have options of the name of the day. I guess it will be better if it has option to do habbit like once, twice, thrice a week. Take example: Workout at Gym. You just can’t 100% sure when to go. Or visit Library. I meant, this is habbit tracker apps and not Scheduling apps, so maybe some those option are more intuitive and make sense. Thanks.
author: Chauxy
